comment: The IN and OUT jacks carry no configInput or configOutput name at all, so Rack shows them unnamed on hover; the panel prints IN and OUT beside them. The maker's manual says a different reset value can be chosen from the context menu: no such item exists in 2.0.3. The value is held in state and saved with the patch (SampleAndUpdate.cpp:172) but there is no way to change it from the interface, so a reset always writes 0V.
